activity.notes: Eight Deer Jaguar Claw (Iya Nacuaa Teyusi Ñaña) is a historically grounded Mixtec ruler whose political biography is preserved in the Mixtec codices. ATLAS does not use generic 'Mixtecs' as a centralized polity; it records his actual city-state lordships. He became ruler of Tututepec (Yucu Dzaa) around 1084 and held it until his death in 1115. Calendar conversions are kept approximate rather than treated as modern Gregorian exact dates.

sources.title: The Complete Codex Zouche-Nuttall — University of Texas Press
sources.citation_text: The scholarly edition treats the reverse of Codex Zouche-Nuttall as the political biography of Eight Deer Jaguar Claw and includes his transition to Tututepec, rule there, alliances and conquests.

sources.title: 50 Features: the Story of Lord Eight Deer Jaguar Claw — UC Davis Library
sources.citation_text: UC Davis describes the codex as preserving Eight Deer's military and political conquests, ceremonies and genealogy, based on the Mixtec pictorial historical tradition.

sources.title: Eight Deer Jaguar Claw
sources.citation_text: The compiled chronology gives Eight Deer as ruler of Tututepec from 1084 to 1115 and Tilantongo from 1097 to 1115, with the chronology based on specialist readings of Mixtec codices.
